requirement: Builder must not be the sole independent evaluator; identities, roles, permissions, conflicts and effective separation must be evidenced.

actors.permission_profile: contents:read; consumes frozen G23 record only

separation_controls: Producer, G23 and G24 execute as separate GitHub-hosted jobs with one-way artifact dependencies.
G23 and G24 use fresh runners and do not execute repair code.
G24 checks equality of candidate digest to G23 accepted digest.
Candidate is frozen before G23 and any change invalidates the G23 record.
Repository rulesets are not assumed because current private-repository API returned plan-related 403.

conflict_of_interest_records.issue: Validator code and candidate currently share repository administration domain.
conflict_of_interest_records.impact: Administrative independence is not yet proven by fresh-runner separation alone.

conflict_of_interest_records.issue: No registered remote Codex environment is currently available as a second evaluator.

fail_closed_rule: G23 MUST HOLD while PUAC.C27 assessment is HOLD.
